## FROZEN EXTERNAL label contract

The exact observed in-feed jar URI (round-tripped unchanged):

```text
jdt://contents/mini-lib-1.0.0.jar/jp.iryo.spike.lib/Calculations.java?=mini-app/%5C/tmp%5C/jdtls_spike_mini%5C/_m2%5C/jp%5C/iryo%5C/spike%5C/mini-lib%5C/1.0.0%5C/mini-lib-1.0.0.jar=/maven.pomderived=/true=/=/maven.groupId=/jp.iryo.spike=/=/maven.artifactId=/mini-lib=/=/maven.version=/1.0.0=/=/maven.scope=/compile=/=/maven.pomderived=/true=/%3Cjp.iryo.spike.lib%28Calculations.class
```

The exact observed JDK/JRT URI:

```text
jdt://contents/java.base/java.util/List.java?=mini-app/%5C/usr%5C/lib%5C/jvm%5C/java-21-openjdk-amd64%5C/lib%5C/jrt-fs.jar%60java.base=/javadoc_location=/https:%5C/%5C/docs.oracle.com%5C/en%5C/java%5C/javase%5C/21%5C/docs%5C/api%5C/=/=/maven.pomderived=/true=/%3Cjava.util%28List.class
```

Derivation rule:

- In-feed jar container `mini-lib-1.0.0.jar` → exact GAV map `jp.iryo.spike:mini-lib:1.0.0` → artifact label `mini-lib`.
- An unmapped external jar uses its URI container basename with the parseable version suffix removed.
- A JDK/JRT URI uses its module container segment verbatim: `java.base` → artifact label `java.base`.
- The entire `jdt://` URI, including its query, is opaque and must round-trip verbatim into `java/classFileContents`.

```java
// Source code is decompiled from a .class file using FernFlower decompiler (from Intellij IDEA).
package jp.iryo.spike.lib;

public final class Calculations {
   public static final String 日本語定数 = "診療";

   private Calculations() {
   }

   public static int calculate(int a, int b) {
      return a + b;
   }

   public static long calculate(long a, long b) {
      return a + b;
   }

   public static int calculate(int... values) {
      int total = 0;

      for(int value : values) {
         total += value;
      }

      return total;
   }

   public static int 点数変換(int 点数) {
      return 点数 * 10;
   }
```

## Three most consequential findings

1. ServiceReady arrived at 3928.66 ms and the first successful cross-jar definition at 7438.936 ms (gap 3510.276 ms); use the semantic cross-artifact warmup as the real barrier.
2. Jar and JDK navigation both use jdt://; attaching sources changes java/classFileContents from FernFlower-decompiled fallback text to the attached source but does not change the URI scheme or container contract.
3. Constructor-chain recommendation is KEEP; the wrapper-default configuration failed on its writable configuration overlay, while two unique configuration sessions reached ready; one idle -Xmx700m server used 1186712 KiB RSS.
